targets.expr: (1 - max by (env,cluster,node) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{env=~"${env:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",node=~"${node:regex}"}) / max by (env,cluster,node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{env=~"${env:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",node=~"${node:regex}"})) and on (env,cluster,node) (max by (env,cluster,node) (up{foundation="true",env=~"${env:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",app=~"${app:regex}",node=~"${node:regex}",pod=~"${pod:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}))
